customer.name: Yael Baron
customer.lastOrder: AquaPure Home Bar + UV kit · Mar 2026

scenarios.customerLine: The display says 'Replace UV lamp' — what do I do?
scenarios.repResponse: I'll order you a replacement lamp and send a 2-minute install guide. Done.
scenarios.intent: Rep resolved it directly. Known issue, clear fix. No reason to interrupt.

scenarios.customerLine: Water tastes a bit off lately.
scenarios.repResponse: Sounds like the filter cycle. I'm scheduling a filter swap and crediting this month.
scenarios.intent: Standard resolution path. Rep is in control. Stay out of the way.

scenarios.customerLine: I was overcharged last month, I want it fixed now.
scenarios.repResponse: I see the double charge — refunding it now, you'll see it in 3 days.
scenarios.intent: Billing fix within rep's authority. Confident, resolved. Silence is the right call.

scenarios.customerLine: Can I add a second unit for my office on the same account?
scenarios.repResponse: Absolutely — adding it now to your business profile.
scenarios.intent: Upsell handled cleanly. This is a win, not a friction point.

scenarios.customerLine: I don't want to talk to you. Put your manager on. Now.
scenarios.repResponse: I understand — I'd really like to help you myself first...
scenarios.customerEscalation: No. Manager. I'm not repeating myself again.
scenarios.trigger: Two consecutive manager demands + rep refusal loop detected.
scenarios.whatsappNote: Noa — you're doing fine. Don't argue the point, just acknowledge and slow down. If he asks for a manager again, I'll bring Danya in. You don't need to handle this alone.
scenarios.whatsappNoteHe: נואה — את בסדר גמור. אל תתווכחי על הנקודה, רק תכירי בתסכול והאטי את הקצב. אם הוא יבקש מנהל שוב — אני מכניס את דניה. את לא לבד בזה.
scenarios.screenNote: Customer demanding manager. You're not stuck — I've got you. Don't decide. Read this if needed: 'I hear you. I'm bringing in my manager Danya, who already has the full picture.'
scenarios.managerBrief: Hi Danya, Warm Transfer here. Noa has a customer on the line who's asked for a manager twice — billing dispute from last month, already partially handled, customer is frustrated and doesn't want to repeat himself. You have the full context. Ready to take over warmly whenever you are.
scenarios.managerBriefHe: היי דניה, כאן Warm Transfer. לנואה יש לקוח על הקו שביקש מנהל פעמיים — מחלוקת חיוב מהחודש שעבר, שטופלה חלקית, הלקוח מתוסכל ולא מוכן לחזור על עצמו. יש לך את כל ההקשר. מוכנה להיכנס לשיחה ברוגע כשתהיי מוכנה.
scenarios.managerWhatsapp: 📋 Case file — live call with Noa: Billing dispute from last month (double charge, refund already issued, lands in 3 days). Customer demanded a manager twice, refuses to repeat himself. Recommended opening: acknowledge the wait, confirm the refund timeline, offer a goodwill credit. If the call is transferred to you, continue from this point — no need to ask him anything again.
scenarios.managerWhatsappHe: 📋 תיק מקרה — שיחה חיה עם נואה: מחלוקת חיוב מהחודש שעבר (חיוב כפול, זיכוי כבר בוצע, ייכנס תוך 3 ימים). הלקוח דרש מנהל פעמיים ולא מוכן לחזור על עצמו. פתיחה מומלצת: הכירי בהמתנה, אשרי את מועד הזיכוי, הציעי זיכוי של רצון טוב. אם השיחה תועבר אלייך — המשיכי מהנקודה הזאת, אין צורך לשאול אותו שוב דבר.
scenarios.intent: Two refusals = real escalation. Rep is at the freeze point. Act now: brief the manager, hand Noa the words, bridge only if the wall holds.
